chunks.title: 2.4 FPPO (Factory Production Process Order)
chunks.heading: Division-wise Transaction Flow › 2. Gurgaon Division › 2.4 FPPO (Factory Production Process Order)
chunks.text:
• Action: FPPO creation of each process.
• Description: The FPPO of Cutting will be of own factory type where cut pcs will be recorded as output. For the process “Quilting”, the team will raise the FPPO to Other Factory “FA Rudrapur” by selecting execution type as “other factory” .
• From FPPO List(Production > Production Process Order > List) required one option “transfer to other factory” need to provide and after selecting the FPPO user will click on “Transfer to other factory” then a pop will open in which user is able to view bind Division with the factory and user is able to select “site” this hyperlink will be enable only execution type other factory, In case of “own factory” & “outsourced” “Transfer to other factory” hyperlink is disabled.
• This hyperlink allows to click for execution type other factory when GDI is not created for input material for that FPPO.
• When user creating the FPPO manually, Transferred Division need to be auto pick from factory’s Division and in FPPO Creation Division system will pick Division of logged In Division.
• When user click on “Transfer to other factory” then a pop will appear where Division will auto selected by FPPO’s Factory’s Division in freeze mode (From Factory Master) and user have to select the site only.
• Note : In Case of Auto created FPPO, in “FPPO creation Division” field Rudarpur Division need to be shown.
chunks.locator: § Division-wise Transaction Flow › 2. Gurgaon Division › 2.4 FPPO (Factory Production Process Order)

chunks.title: 2.4 FPPO (Factory Production Process Order)
chunks.heading: Division-wise Transaction Flow › 2. Gurgaon Division › 2.4 FPPO (Factory Production Process Order)
chunks.text:
• Note :- Below List(Old & New) will be accessible where FPPO Creation division is matching to logged in Division.
• Review Hyperlink link also required after clicking on it user will redirected on factory production process order list screen (Production > Factory Production Order > FPO List – New > Factory Production Process Order hyperlink > Ordered Qty.).
Once user “Confirm” from the pop-up, system will create new FPPO (Own Factory) automatically in Rudrapur Division and Original FPPO’s(Gurgaon Division) qty will get Zero but in non-cancel mode. System will automatically create Transfer to Site GDI against the Gurgaon Division FPPO. As mentioned in 1.5 Point (Material Dispatch (Transfer to Site)) Screen.
• System will create GDI from input material sites defined in FPPO, it can be single/Multiple.
• The Auto Created FPPO that will create in Rudarpur division, input dispatch site & output received site should be same(To Site selected in Gurgaon division).
• In case user cancel(Parent FPPO) the transferred FPPO then “Auto Created ” GDI, FPPO in Rudarpur Division need to be cancel automatically.
• In case GDN is created/child FPPO split/Revise FPPO, then system will not allow to user cancel the Parent FPPO.
• User is also able to define price for other factory FPPO.

chunks.heading: Division-wise Transaction Flow › 3. Rudrapur Division › 3.1 Transfer from Site (Receiving of Input Items from GGN)
chunks.text:
• Action:
• User will be able to do the receiving of Transfer to site created in Gurgaon Division (Section 1.5)
• Upon creation of this transfer, the material received at the site will be auto reserved against this FPO (Section 2.2,2.3)
• Reference of Parent Dispatch from Gurgaon FPPO to be maintained.
• Description: The system will give a provision to the users of Rudrapur division to receive the material against the transfer to site (Section 1.5) created in Gurgaon Division and upon receiving of this, the material will get auto reserved to the FPO created in Rudrapur division.
• QC will not allowed for transferred material.
• No material movement/adjustment will allowed for transferred material in Rudarpur division.

chunks.title: 3.2 FPPO Creation (By Splitting of Auto Created FPPO of Rudarpur Division)
chunks.heading: Division-wise Transaction Flow › 3. Rudrapur Division › 3.2 FPPO Creation (By Splitting of Auto Created FPPO of Rudarpur Division)
chunks.text:
• In Rudarpur Division for quilting process system will show two FPPO’s one with zero Quantity i.e for Gurgaon division and another with full Qty. for Rudarpur division (which is auto created by Gurgaon division) as mentioned in below screen.
Note: A division column need to add in above screen.
• Action: Required a provision where user can split whole/Partial to create the outsource FPPO of quilting process if required.
• Description: The system will give user a provision to create a child FPPO in Rudrapur based on the parent auto created FPPO raised by the Gurgaon division.
• The qty for which the child FPPO can create by Rudrapur Division through split, that qty will get reduced from the parent auto created FPPO in Gurgaon Division.
Step 1: - RDP team is creating a Outsource FPPO by Splitting the Parent auto created FPPO.
• Qty from GGN to RDP: - 6000
• RDP Creates 3000 Units order to Outsource (Screens Below).
• Balance Qty left in Parent FPPO: - 3000
After doing that, the Parent auto created FPPO which was created from GGN to RDP will get reduced by 3000 Units and we will see a new Row in the FPPO screen showing the order created in RDP division.
Note: User will be able to see Only those FPPOs of the division and Factory in FPPO list for which he has the permission.
chunks.locator: § Division-wise Transaction Flow › 3. Rudrapur Division › 3.2 FPPO Creation (By Splitting of Auto Created FPPO of Rudarpur Division)

chunks.title: 3.3 Material Dispatch
chunks.heading: Division-wise Transaction Flow › 3. Rudrapur Division › 3.3 Material Dispatch
chunks.text:
• Action:
• The input material will be dispatched to the outsource Job worker against this FPPO.
• Reference of Parent-FPPO and Parent-Dispatch will be maintained.
• Description: The material for outsourcing is dispatched to the job worker with a Child-Dispatch-Note, and references to the parent FPPO and dispatch are maintained. The dispatch type here will be as usual “Production Process Order Output”
• Available site stock will not have hyperlink to allocate the material (In case auto created FPPO & Splitted FPPO.)
• The user is able to revise the auto-generated FPPO up to the quantity that was originally created.
• For example – OC is created of 120 PCS and FPPO is auto-created for 100 units. when user update or modify the FPPO, qty will be update originally created quantity of 100 units. they can revise the quantity, but not exceed the initial 100 units.
• Case 1
• Company A have OC of 120
• User trasnffered FPPO for 100 qty in Rudarpur Company(Company B).
• Then user is able to do modification(Creating order in Rudarpur or outsourcing the order) in Rudarpur company upto 100 Qty.
Note: - Additional (Adhoc) material can also be dispatched against the above FPPO.
Once the materials are dispatched to Outsource vendors in FA RDP. Against that GDN, the Eway bill and E Invoice can be created.
Once the GDN is created then that will be moved to GST Doc Integration for Eway bill.

chunks.text:
• Action:
• Handling of Additional Process in RDP other than Quilting.
• The additional Processes Created in RDP will have ref of Parent FPPO Created in GGN division.
• Description: The GGN division will give the Order of Quilting to RDP Division. But RDP division can do some additional Process also against that Order. So, this will be handled via GRN Receiving New > List > update re-process hyperlink as mentioned in below screen where the Source of the Stock (Parent FPPO / FPPO Created in RDP for quilting Process) is maintained.
• Once User click on update “Add Process” hyperlink then below mentioned screen will open, where user will Add–Process before/After the Quilting process (Stock should be available at that moment).
User will create a FPPO as per above screen & Add extra input items in Article tab as attached in below screen confirm the transaction system will create a FPPO of added process type in FPO List as mentioned in below screen.
As soon as user confirm and release the production system will create a GDI along with picklist of output semi-finished material which need to sent to Supplier/Factory as mentioned in below screen.
User will create GDN as manually as mentioned in below screen.

• As soon as misc. sales invoice created in rudarpur division system will show data in Pending supplier invoice tab below screen mentioned.
